open_question_answered.question: when a lane's classification is degenerate but defensible under a loose reading of the brief, is that a defect in the model or in the brief?
open_question_answered.answer: the metric alone cannot say. The race_grading_evidence is the cross-check — the T893 adjudication splits the C3 penalties between 'the brief owned it' (no legal class existed for 19 of the rows; class (d) was added by the adjudicator) and 'the model owned it' (rows with a clean answer that the lane still mis-classified). The ledger carries the metric (paths_real high, discernment_entropy 0.17); the grader carries the attribution.
open_question_answered.generalisation: the pair (canary_recall, false_flag_rate) is the audit-specific pair; the pair (paths_real, discernment_entropy) is the task-type-general pair. They measure different failure modes and one scalar cannot say so — the two-field discipline the brief insists on, arriving from a second task type. The schema records both pairs.
open_question_answered.where_recorded: schema §3 'Three generalisations the T750 amendment demands'

operator_ruling_2026-08-24.quote: Haiku was just incompetant or lazy. However, it's possible that GLM may have had too-high standards. Technically, even if poor evidence is on disk, they are all strictly re-runnable.
operator_ruling_2026-08-24.interpretation: the operator distinguishes the failure modes: haiku was under-effort (low paths_real, low discernment — the model did not look); glm was over-rigorous (high paths_real, low discernment — the model looked thoroughly then answered wrongly). The ledger records both via the same metric, and a report that wants to attribute the failure has to look at both numbers. One scalar collapses them; two do not.
operator_ruling_2026-08-24.where_applied: the Race C3 glm-5.2 and claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 rows already carry the distinguishing numbers (paths_real 42 vs 14, discernment_entropy 0.17 vs 0.17 — same entropy, different investigative effort). The report reader has the data; the schema refuses to make them average.
